meta.name: appropriateness-bounding
meta.description: Establish acceptability standards through RAND/UCLA Appropriateness Method or Consensus Conference protocols.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过结构化方法制定专业领域的接受标准。
copy.tagline_en: Establish consensus standards using RAND/UCLA method
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to define acceptability criteria through structured expert consensus.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会使用RAND/UCLA方法或共识会议流程，收集多轮专家评分、组织讨论、重新评分，最终将每个项目分类为“合适”、“不确定”或“不合适”，并报告分歧点。
howto.when: 当你问“某个做法在某种情境下是否合适”，或需要制定医疗指南、监管标准、接受阈值时触发。

say.text: 判断以下治疗方案在老年患者中是否合适。
say.note: Claude会执行两轮评分与讨论流程。

say.text: 评估这项政策在低收入区域的可接受性。
say.note: 各项目将被分类，并显示分歧情况。

say.text: 列出分歧点并给出共识建议。
say.note: Claude汇总讨论结果并生成报告。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude uses the RAND/UCLA method or consensus conference process: collects multi-round expert ratings, facilitates discussion, re-rates, and classifies each item as appropriate, uncertain, or inappropriate, reporting any disagreement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask 'is X appropriate when Y?' or need to set thresholds for medical guidelines, regulations, or acceptability standards.

say_en.text: Assess whether the following treatments are appropriate for elderly patients.
say_en.note: Claude runs a two-round rating and discussion process.

say_en.text: Evaluate the acceptability of this policy in low-income areas.
say_en.note: Items are classified with disagreement flags.

say_en.text: List points of disagreement and provide consensus recommendations.
say_en.note: Claude synthesizes discussion and generates a report.
